fields.title: Buddies Collectibles Casual Commander Night
fields.details: Wizards/EventLink lists a recurring Saturday 10:30 PM Buddies Collectibles Casual Commander Night with $10 entry and 12-player capacity. The late time is unusual but plausible against Buddies' listed Friday/Saturday late hours; keep it visible as source-backed rather than guessing an earlier start.

fields.assessment_notes: Buddies Collectibles remains a useful but commerce-heavy Gardena TCG lead. The official site and Linktree support current identity, Magic product depth, weekly tournament infrastructure, live-stream commerce, and a broad social route map. Wizards/EventLink now supports both Friday 6:30 PM casual Commander and Saturday 10:30 PM Casual Commander Night. Direct Yelp and review mirrors support generally positive store-quality signals, but also preserve pricing/business-model cautions. The official Discord was inspected at first-pass depth: it is active and sizable, with events, meet-ups, gaming, trade/sell, and general community channels, but visible first-pass content was mostly commerce/community/card-show/trade-night oriented and did not prove Commander turnout, proxy norms, or solo-arrival texture. Treat Buddies as a real current TCG/community venue with actionable Commander rows, but not yet a proven relaxed Commander fit.

operations.reason: Reflect the inspected Discord/community route and the newly surfaced Saturday Commander row without overclaiming lived Commander texture.

fields.assessment_notes: B.Y.O.GAMES is a nontraditional but increasingly credible East LA gaming-lounge candidate. Wizards/EventLink continues to support Tuesday and Wednesday Commander with unusually useful details: casual/warm-up/free-play language, four-player pod minimum, Bracket 3-4, no infinites, Rule Zero encouragement, and paid tournament structure. LAist/Boyle Heights Beat describes BYO as a real community third place and explicitly shows/mentions Magic: The Gathering activity, while Roadtrippers/Yelp-derived reviews add current-looking hours/status, welcoming staff, huge gaming space, and a November 2025 Magic-player report that BYO runs trading-card-game tournaments. The main caution is personal fit and distance, not existence: the no-infinites/Bracket 3-4 language and mixed gaming-lounge setting need a focused solo-arrival/proxy/turnout read before treating it as a default Commander plan.

fields.assessment_notes: Grails Gone Wild should be read as a Grails/GGW Cards N Collects alias cluster with current source support, not merely a maybe-closed record. Current Wizards/EventLink export supports the Sunday 1:30 PM Casual Commander row through August 2026, resolving the biggest calendar uncertainty from the earlier targeted Instagram correction. GGW Cards N Collects storefront, KeepUp/Card Shop Hub, Trading Card Database, TCGplayer, Ravensburger/Lorcana, BBB, and Instagram collectively support a likely active TCG storefront at the Torrance identity cluster, while MapQuest/Yelp-derived closure remains a weaker conflict signal. Instagram remains stale for MTG community proof: it supports store-controlled identity and 2025 TCG/MTG activity, not current Commander texture. Treat Grails as a real but still lower-priority Sunday Commander lead until community/review texture improves.
